blocks.text: LN LENQIN Watches for Women Stainless Steel Ladies Watches Analog Quartz Strap Extensible Wrist Watch

items.label: ⌚Ladies Watches Elegant Design
items.value: With its unique oval design dial, stylish lightweight and elegant look, it can be worn with any outfit, making it a minimalist watch for everyday wear. It is the perfect accent for any ladies wrist and a great choice for casual and formal occasions.

items.label: ⌚Womens Watch Stainless Steel Band
items.value: Ladies analog watch made with anti-scratch mineral dial window, exquisitely crafted. Stretchable and elasticated strap Easy to wear,wear-resistant and scratch-resistant, breathable, easy to maintain.

items.label: ⌚Accurate Time Keeping
items.value: Simple round dial and Powerful high-quality quartz analog movement and battery, keep long-term operation,provide precise time keeping. The Women watch perfect for your loved ones.

items.label: ⌚3 ATM Waterproof Ladies Watch
items.value: Handwash, sweat-proof, rain-proof, no problem! But NOT suitable for bathing, swimming, diving. NOTE: Please DO NOT press any buttons in the water, or touching hot water.

items.label: ⌚ AFTER-SALES SERVICE
items.value: Exquisite stainless steel women's watches, can be matched with any occasion clothes. Our store provides 24-hour customer service for you, any questions about ladies watches, please don't hesitate to contact us.
